text:
emily: rolled v7-int4 as a 6% canary at 04:20. infra and latency look fine but we see a subtle distribution drift for "developer_docs" slice: KL up +0.011 and short_answer_mrr down 1.9% (ctrl=0.298 trt=0.292, n~5.4k each, p=0.014). want to define an entropy-aware rollback rule before we expand. cc @rahul @nia

rahul: thanks. two concerns: KL shifts can be noisy for templated docs, and small MRR deltas may be acceptable if entropy/creativity improves. propose a composite rule that considers both fidelity and token-distribution drift.

nia: sketch of policy I'd support:
- Preconditions: per-slice window=15m, min_samples=1000 to count.
- Primary trigger (rollback): ANY of
  1) short_answer_mrr relative delta <= -2.0% AND p <= 0.01 (n>=2k)
  2) KL_divergence >= 0.010 AND short_answer_mrr_rel <= -1.0% (n>=1.5k)
  3) token_entropy drop >= 0.25 bits AND hallucination_abs increase >= 0.3% (either p<=0.05)
- Investigate-only band: KL in [0.007,0.010) OR MRR_rel in [-2.0%,-1.0%) -> page ML + SRE but do not auto-rollback.
- Hysteresis: require trigger condition to be true for 2 consecutive 15m windows (prevent single-window flaps).
- Monotonicity: for KL and entropy triggers require monotonic change across windows.
- Adaptive-sampling: when KL crosses 0.007, automatically spawn a targeted smoke-run of 10k synthetic prompts for that slice and reduce live canary to 1% while the run is pending.

emily: love the adaptive-sampling idea. ensures we get power before a rollback flips. add that any auto-rollback attaches a 1k-random-sample CSV and the smoke-run id to the audit ticket.

rollout-bot: draft CLI to create policy:
```
/rollout create-policy --model v7-int4 --name entropy-aware-guard-3334 --min-samples 1000 --mrr-rule "rel:-0.02:p<=0.01:n>=2000:2x15m" --kl-rule "abs:0.010:and:mrr_rel<=-0.01:n>=1500:monotonic:2x15m" --entropy-rule "drop:0.25:p<=0.05:and:halluc_abs>=0.003:monotonic:2x15m" --investigate-bands "kl:0.007-0.010|mrr_rel:-0.02:-0.01" --adaptive-sample 10000 --shrink-canary 1% --attach-samples 1000 --notify #incidents --audit true
```

sam: small tweak: for templated docs we should detect high token-repetition (n-gram repeat >0.35) and relax KL threshold by +0.005 to avoid false-positives. also log the top-10 ngram-shifts on investigate alerts.

rahul: yes add a per-slice masker: if ngram_repeat>0.35 then kl_threshold += 0.005 for that slice. and require KL p<=0.05.

nia: agree. also require that adaptive-sampling results are auto-attached to the rollout ticket and the policy pauses auto-rollback until sample analysis completes or 2 windows elapse. we don't want to auto-rollback mid-investigation.

emily: ok final plan: 1) create policy with entropy-aware + ngram relaxation 2) shrink canary to 1% and kick off adaptive 10k smoke-run for developer_docs 3) wait for either 2 windows post-shrink OR smoke-run finish 4) if triggers still hold -> auto-rollback and audit export. I'll create the rollout ticket and paste the smoke link.

rollout-bot: policy created: id=entropy-aware-guard-3334. adaptive-sampling and shrink-to-1% enabled. will post alerts to #incidents and attach sample exports on rollback.

sam: thanks. ping this thread with the smoke-run id and the two-window summary. :thumbsup:
